## SuperSubtitler 0.4.1 — the best audio track of every language

Update with **About → Update window and SuperSubtitler** (from 0.3.5 on), or download both files into one folder.

### 🎚️ Automatic track choice
- Films often carry the same language several times — TrueHD 7.1, AC3 5.1, stereo, a commentary, an audio description. SuperSubtitler now **listens to every track first** and measures how well the speech model understands each one (how sure it is of what it hears — music, noise or a muddy mix lower that).
- Per language, the **best-understood track is suggested** and ticked (★). When two are about equally clear, the one with a centre channel (dialogue on its own), then a lossless format, then the higher bit rate wins. **Commentaries and audio descriptions are never suggested.**
- You confirm with one click or change the ticks; with *Never ask* (`-auto`) the suggested tracks are taken directly. *Use for all following files* now takes the best track of each remembered language.
- Console: Enter takes the suggested tracks, `all` takes every track.
- The analysis takes a little longer for files with many tracks, since each one is listened to.

The exes are not code-signed; Windows SmartScreen may warn — "More info" → "Run anyway". Built by GitHub Actions.
